description: This file defines the LeaveOverlapAPI class, which is a REST API endpoint for retrieving overlapping leave records within a Human Resource Management system. It handles parameters for date ranges, employee numbers, and leave durations, and integrates with underlying leave service classes to fetch and process leave overlap data.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\\Leave\\Api\\\LeaveOverlapAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for fetching overlapping leaves within a specified date range for a given employee. Implements methods to get data, validate parameters, and handle leave overlap logic.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve overlapping leave records, optionally including data about whether work shift length is exceeded.
